_doc: The Cosmos meshes taken out of the Demonic Village pack (extract.py) and moved to /Game/Licensed/CosmosChurch/Village in a throwaway 5.8 project (migrate.py). The pack's names say nothing (SM_Cemetery01 to 10), so they were chosen by their measures and triangle counts and then looked at in place in the game: plain grave markers only, and a bench. What was left out and why is in README.md.
